name: an EMPTY rollup reads as fine instead of NO CHECKS
expect: ⭐ an EMPTY rollup says NO CHECKS — the PR #407 state the handoff missed

name: failures are no longer counted as fail
expect: a mixed rollup is summarised with failures first

name: a malformed rollup member is dropped silently
expect: a malformed rollup member is COUNTED as unreadable, not dropped

name: the newest record is picked by name, not round number
edits: if m and (best is None or n.strip() > best):
expect: the newest record is the highest ROUND, numerically, whatever the subject is called

name: closed bets are shown as open
edits:
if r.get("outcome") is not None:
            continue
expect: only ADDED rows still awaiting an outcome are open; a bad added row is COUNTED

name: ⭐ clean() no longer strips newlines (block forgery returns)
expect: ⭐ clean() makes a value one inert line: no newline, no control char, no `===`

name: ⭐ gh failing prints an empty list instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: L.append(f"OPEN PRS: CANNOT RUN — {clean(pr_error)}. Treat as NOT CHECKED, never as 'nothing open'.")
expect: ⭐ gh failing prints CANNOT RUN — never an empty list

name: a failed fetch is not flagged
expect: a failed fetch is flagged as possibly STALE

name: ⭐ a branch that added no record prints nothing (r1 B1)
edits: L.append(f"      latest review: {clean(info['record']) if info['record'] else none}")
expect: ⭐ a branch that added no record SAYS so — absence is never silent (r1 CLAUDE B1)

name: ⭐ an empty ledger reads as 'empty' again (r1 B2)
edits:
L.append(f"IN-FLIGHT LEDGER ({LEDGER_REL}): none RECORDED — it is written by hand (`--add`), "
                 "so empty is not proof that nothing is running.")
expect: ⭐ an empty ledger says none RECORDED — never 'nothing running' (r1 CLAUDE B2)

name: ⭐ an unreadable ledger line is dropped on the next write (r1 P2)
expect: ⭐ ...and an update KEEPS them verbatim instead of erasing them (r1 CODEX P2)

name: ⭐ the ledger lock is dropped (r1 P1 race)
expect: ⭐ 20 concurrent adds keep all 20 jobs (r1: an unlocked write kept 3)

name: records are read from a FORK's same-named branch
expect: a fork PR says its records were NOT READ instead of showing this repo's same-named branch

name: ⭐ no total deadline (r1 P1)
expect: ⭐ a total DEADLINE stops branch reads and the block still prints, counting what was NOT READ (r1 P1)

name: ⭐ main() no longer prints the block
expect: ⭐ main() PRINTS the block — the hook's whole output (r1: removing the print stayed green)
